_note: DATA, not logic. Every rule and threshold of `npm run graph:build` (seed/graph/build.ts). Colour words come from server/src/vocab.json (colours.*.terms), never repeated here. Edit, then re-run `npm run graph:build` (idempotent).

family._doc: variant_of. Group extracted recipes of one pack by (normalised folder, name stem), where stem/folder drop colour words and version tokens; then keep only members whose payload has the SAME node count and the SAME node signature (node paths + enabled modules). Members of a confirmed group get meta.family and a variant_of edge to the canonical member (lowest slug).

pairs._doc: pairs_with. Same pack + same stem + same variant key (colours + versions + suffix words), with >= minRoles distinct roles. A role is detected from the prefab NAME tokens (role.terms, singularised); role.alsoStrip tokens are removed from the stem too. Every member of a role is linked to every member of the other roles.

assets._doc: Asset nodes = material / texture / shader / mesh references (by GUID) found in extracted payloads. builtinGuidPattern marks Unity built-in resources (external, never a similarity signal).

similarity._doc: similar_to. Jaccard over the (non-builtin, non-external) materials+textures a recipe uses. Assets used by more than maxAssetFanout recipes carry no signal (shared atlas) and are skipped. Each recipe keeps its topK best neighbours with jaccard >= minJaccard (out-degree cap); same-family pairs are excluded (variant_of covers them).

knowledge._doc: applies_to. seed/graph/knowledge-links.json maps hand-written technique/component/shader/code records to the recipe facets they apply to. At most maxPerKnowledge recipes per record: hand-written first, then one per family, round-robin across packs.
